name: IT-Tools
description: A browser-based collection of developer and sysadmin utilities, with no account setup.

connection.title: Open IT-Tools
connection.description: A collection of developer and sysadmin utilities. No login, no setup, nothing stored.

outputs.label: IT-Tools
outputs.help: Opens the tool collection. No sign-in required.

firstLogin.note: Nothing to log into and nothing persisted — every tool runs in your browser. Anyone who can reach this URL can use it, so keep it internal if that matters.

features.title: Developer utilities
features.description: Keep useful engineering tools in one place.

features.title: Browser interface
features.description: No separate desktop installation is needed.

features.title: Simple setup
features.description: The app does not require account setup.

deploymentRecipes.label: IT-Tools on Fly.io
deploymentRecipes.notes: Developer utilities execute in your browser. The web server requires no database or persistent volume. Creates a dedicated Fly app and one shared-CPU Machine. Deletion removes its Machine and the app only when no other Machines or volumes exist.
